purpose: Original continuous surface colors for semantically assigned UV islands on the kingdom guard; no plate shapes or character features are projected from the concept image.
source: builtin-imagegen; original generated image; no third-party meshes, rigs, motion, or textures

mode_inference_decision.rationale: The source is fully opaque generated material color. Its deterministic crop and mirror tile operation is a 3D material-specific extension; runtime_atlas_pack would incorrectly imply already approved input assets.

source_format.layout: 2x2 equal quadrants without lines, labels, frames, or margins
source_format.accepted_size: square, at least 1024 pixels per edge; actual dimensions recorded in QA

quadrants.top_left: even silver steel with subtle brushed wear

postprocess.method: For each source quadrant, crop its exact centered quarter-width square, except navy cloth uses [157,873,470,1186] on the selected 1254-square source to avoid a repeat band. Resize to 256x256. Compose source pixels as [patch, horizontal mirror; vertical mirror, horizontal+vertical mirror] into an opaque 512x512 RGB PNG. No color painting, new noise, graphics, inpainting, or baked labels.
postprocess.coordinate_policy: Computed from actual source dimensions; exact coordinates logged in QA.

alpha_policy: Opaque RGB material for continuous 3D UV surfaces. Magenta chroma-key is intentionally inapplicable.
qa_gates: Source SHA256 and exact crop coordinates recorded
Per-material color-domain checks and adequate microtexture variation
Exact tile-edge equality from source-pixel mirror construction
2x2 repeats for each tile inspected visually for visible motifs and directional light
No text, armor plates, insignia, rivets, visor slit, silhouette, perspective, or background
No claim that these RGB tiles are measured PBR maps; metalness and roughness require author settings and assembly review

review.assembly_surface: Original kingdom guard 3D model with semantic material assignments
